simple.meaning: שֶׁאֱרָה (Sheʼĕrâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “Sheerah , an Israelitess.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

definitions.full: H7609. Sheerah שֶׁאֱרָה proper name, feminine 'daughter' of Ephraim ; — שׁ ׳בִּתּוֺ 1Chr 7:24 (see also proper name, of a location שׁ ׳אֻזֵּן above); ᵐ5 B ἐκείνοις τ. καταλοίποις , but ᵐ5 L (compare ᵐ5 A ) ἡ θυγάτηρ αὐτοῦ Σαραα . מִשְׁאֶרֶת see above שֵׁאת see שׁאה .
